comment: The embedded T3 server: the T3 Code CLI archive (Node single executable) of upstream main at the reference pin 5d3d78ab93, which reports version 0.1.6 (CLIENT_VERSION, version-skew.ts). No release publishes this commit, so the archive is built locally the way .github/workflows/release-desktop.yml builds the macOS arm64 one (`build`), and the committed hash is the only anchor: there is no SHA256SUMS and no download. The workflow signs with a Developer ID only when CSC_LINK is set; without it, as here, every Mach-O file is signed ad hoc, which `codesign --verify --strict` still checks for integrity. stage-runtime.mjs takes the archive from .runtime-cache, checks it against this hash and puts it beside this file; the app unpacks it into <T3 home>/runtime/versions/<version> at first launch. T3 Code is MIT (LICENSE-T3).

steps: node scripts/build-cli-archive.ts --platform mac --arch arm64 --version 0.1.6 --resource-monitor-dir <dir holding darwin-arm64/t3-resource-monitor> --output-dir release-cli
